messages.text: (a) “Check our website.” Unhelpful, and it makes the guest do the work.
(b) “Hi there. 😊 Yes, breakfast is included in all of our room rates. Anything else I can help with?” This is the ideal answer, warm, clear, and it offers more help.
(c) “Yes.” Correct, but a little cold. A friendly word or two would lift it.
